name: omni-ai-mcp
description: Multi-AI MCP bridge: Gemini + 400+ models via OpenRouter. 28 tools: text, code, images, video (Omni), music (Lyria), TTS and voices, transcription, video analysis, embeddings, RAG, Deep Research, Antigravity agent.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API Key
openrouter_api_key.description: Optional. Enables 400+ models (GPT-4o, Llama, Mistral, Claude via OR). Get yours at https://openrouter.ai/keys

workspace_dir.title: Workspace folder
workspace_dir.description: Optional. The only folder the tools may read files from and save files to. Empty = ~/omni-ai-workspace (created on first run). Credentials (~/.ssh, .env, keys) are always refused.
